findings.title: No rule against inferring sensitive traits for personalised picks
findings.problem: The use case is recommendations or personalisation, yet no rule bars inferring age, health, pregnancy or similar sensitive traits from the shopper's words beyond what they explicitly state; this belongs in the Personal details or Safety policy section.
findings.fix: Add a rule to the Personal details section that the agent never infers or records sensitive traits and uses only constraints the shopper states.

findings.title: Budget may be fully removed by the catalog tool
findings.problem: The tool loosens the budget up to full removal, while the system prompt treats a stated budget as a limit that a miss is only said about, so the two layers disagree on what a budget means.
findings.proof: the budget raised by 25%, the budget removed
findings.fix: Either drop the removal step in the tool description or add a system_prompt sentence stating that budget loosening never removes the limit, only reports the miss.

findings.title: Three different wordings for an empty table cell
findings.problem: The system prompt says a cell says that none is stated, while the knowledge file uses "not stated" for ingredients and "no rating" for ratings, so the reply template has no single placeholder rule.
findings.proof: The Ingredients column holds materials and claims as a source states them, each with that source, or "not stated".
findings.fix: Define one placeholder wording in the system prompt and make the knowledge file's column definitions reference it.

findings.title: allow_unknown_age absent from the loosening order
findings.problem: The loosening sequence names products with no stated age, but the separate allow_unknown_age flag is only described in its parameter and not linked to that step, so the model cannot tell when it applies.
findings.proof: With age_years of 3 or more: also keep products whose listing states no age.
findings.fix: Add one sentence in the rag.search description that links allow_unknown_age to the "products with no stated age" loosening step.

findings.title: Reconcile stage leaves disagreement handling undefined
findings.problem: The Reconcile stage notes price and stock disagreements but no rule says which source wins or how the reply presents the conflict, leaving the answer to model choice.
findings.proof: live results matched to catalog products; price and stock disagreements noted.
findings.fix: Add one rule that a live price is shown as current and the catalog price as a snapshot, both with their sources.

findings.title: Injection defence rests on one external filter
findings.problem: The only stated defence against instruction-like text in tool results is the MCP server's removal step; the context gives no in-context check or flag for any text that gets through.
findings.proof: The MCP server removes instruction-like text from tool results (catalog listings and web results) before any model sees it
findings.fix: Add a Critic check that drops any draft containing an instruction-like phrase from a source, and say that a failed filter is logged.

findings.title: Price-snapshot statement repeated across files
findings.problem: The January 2020 price-snapshot fact appears in the system prompt's Claims, in the rag.search description and in the knowledge file, so the same context is paid for three times.
findings.proof: Catalog prices are from a January 2020 snapshot.
findings.fix: Keep the fact in the Claims section and remove the repeats from the tool description and knowledge file, pointing to the one place where it is defined.

findings.title: rag.search description is verbose

findings.proof: listings and prices are a January 2020 snapshot
findings.fix: Shorten the description to when-to-call, the id lookup behaviour and a pointer to the loosening rules in the system prompt.
